arguments.message: If you’ve upgraded to a new phone, the authenticator app on the new device generates different codes because the original secret was tied to the old install. To fix this, go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**, tap **Reset**, and then set up 2FA again just like a first‑time enrollment – scan the new QR code and confirm with the fresh six‑digit code. If you still have a recovery code from the original enrollment, you can use that to sign in and reset the 2FA settings instead.
